_comment: Per-skill TUNABLE CONSTANTS for the design phase — the knobs an org turns WITHOUT rewriting the mapping algorithm. Referenced by phases/design/design-mapping.md; never inline these in step prose (see docs/unit-taxonomy-spec.md 'Knowledge / contract / procedure separation'). NOT algorithm, NOT output contract (that is schemas/aws-design.schema.json).

engine_versions._comment: Default engine versions for designed managed services. Bump on the provider's release cadence — unrelated to the mapping algorithm. (See the MCP refactor's EKS k8s-version port-time-constant lesson.)

new_vpc._comment: Default VPC topology generated when no existing peered VPC is referenced. An org may tune CIDR / AZ count without touching how resources map.

security_group._comment: Service port reference data + SG name patterns + egress. include_port_when names the design condition under which each inbound port is added (a service-port fact, not algorithm).

postgres.include_port_when: an RDS/Aurora service is in the design

redis.include_port_when: an ElastiCache service is in the design

kafka.include_port_when: an MSK service is in the design

security_group.restricted_cidr_source: space config.peering.peer_cidr if present, else the VPC/app CIDR

patterns._comment: Naming/string patterns for generated values. Placeholders {app}/{process_type} are filled at design time.

fir._comment: Fir-generation handling is detect-only in v1 (NEVER emit ARM/Graviton/CNB). These are the fixed notation strings.
fir.deferral_note: Fir-generation workloads detected. No Fir-specific Terraform (ARM/Graviton instance targeting, CNB buildpack configuration) is generated in v1. These workloads are deferred to a future version.
fir.none_note: No Fir workloads detected; all Cedar generation.

messages._comment: Fixed warning/diagnostic strings the procedure emits. {app}/{pipeline} filled at runtime.
messages.empty_procfile: No process types declared for app {app}. At least one process type is required in the Procfile.
messages.pipeline_detect_only: Pipeline '{pipeline}' detected — CI/CD mapping requires manual configuration
